content: Give me a complete daily health plan covering my meals, workout, and hydration.

👋 **Hello shruti!** Here is your personalized recommendation from your AI Health Coaching Team tailored for your goal: **Stay Fit / Maintenance**.


--- 
#### 🏷️ Contribution from **Nutrition Agent**
### 🥗 Nutrition Coach Recommendation for shruti

**Target Goal**: Maintenance (1326 kcal/day)
**Diet Preference**: Non-Vegetarian

#### 📊 Recommended Daily Macronutrient Breakdown:
- **Protein**: ~82.9g (25% of daily intake)
- **Carbohydrates**: ~165.8g (50%)
- **Healthy Fats**: ~36.8g (25%)

#### 🍽️ Sample 1-Day Meal Plan tailored for Stay Fit / Maintenance:
- 🌅 **Breakfast**: 3 Whole Eggs (scrambled/boiled), 2 slices Whole Wheat Toast & avocado.
- ☀️ **Lunch**: Grilled Chicken Breast (200g) with Brown Rice, Steamed Broccoli & olive oil.
- ☕ **Snack**: Handful of mixed nuts (Walnuts & Almonds) + Green Tea or Protein Shake.
- 🌙 **Dinner**: Pan-seared Fish or Chicken Breast with grilled asparagus & baked sweet potato.

💡 *Top Nutrition Tip*: Prioritize **Chicken Breast, Eggs, Fish (Salmon/Tuna), Greek Yogurt, and Cottage Cheese** to hit your daily protein goal cleanly! Ensure you eat within 45 minutes after workouts for optimal recovery.


--- 
#### 🏷️ Contribution from **Fitness Agent**
### 🏋️ Fitness Coach Routine for shruti

**Primary Goal**: Stay Fit / Maintenance | **Program Type**: Full Body Functional Fitness & Mobility
**User Activity Profile**: Sedentary (Little/no exercise) (Age: 20)

#### ⏱️ Warm-Up (5 Minutes):
- 2 mins Arm circles & torso twists
- 3 mins Dynamic leg swings & light jumping jacks

#### 💪 Recommended Routine (General strength, posture, and cardiovascular endurance):
- **Bodyweight Squats**: 3 Sets x 12 Reps *(Rest: 60 sec rest)*
- **Standard Push-ups**: 3 Sets x 10 Reps *(Rest: 60 sec rest)*
- **Glute Bridges**: 3 Sets x 15 Reps *(Rest: 45 sec rest)*
- **Doorway or Dumbbell Rows**: 3 Sets x 12 Reps *(Rest: 60 sec rest)*
- **Bird-Dog & Cat-Cow Mobility**: 3 Sets x 10 Reps/side *(Rest: 30 sec rest)*

#### 🧘 Cool-Down & Recovery (3 Minutes):
- Hamstring stretch (30s hold per leg)
- Chest opener stretch (30s hold)
- Deep diaphragmatic breathing

💡 *Trainer's Tip*: Focus on controlled form over heavy weight. Take at least 1-2 rest days per week for optimal muscle repair!


--- 
#### 🏷️ Contribution from **Lifestyle Agent**
### 🌿 Lifestyle & Recovery Guide for shruti

#### 💧 Hydration Target:
- **Daily Requirement**: **~1.6 Liters** (approx. 6 glasses of water/day).
- **Pro Tip**: Drink 500ml (2 glasses) immediately upon waking up to kickstart metabolism and rehydrate after sleep.

#### 😴 Sleep Hygiene Protocol (Target: 7.5 - 8.5 Hours):
- **Blue Light Cutoff**: Turn off screens (phone, laptop, TV) 45 minutes before sleep or use night-shift mode.
- **Sleep Environment**: Keep room dark, cool (~18-21°C / 65-70°F), and quiet.
- **Consistency**: Go to bed and wake up within the same 30-minute window every day to lock in your circadian rhythm.

#### 🧘 Stress Reduction & Habit Stacking:
- **Box Breathing (4-4-4-4)**: Inhale 4s, Hold 4s, Exhale 4s, Hold 4s (perform 5 cycles whenever feeling stressed).
- **Daily Movement**: Take a 10-minute walk after lunch or dinner to assist digestion and steady blood sugar.
- **Sunlight Exposure**: Get 10-15 minutes of natural morning sunlight within 1 hour of waking up.

💡 *Wellness Tip*: Recovery is where progress happens! High stress raises cortisol, which can slow down stay fit / maintenance progress.




> ⚠️ **Safety Disclaimer**: *This application provides general educational health & fitness suggestions powered by AI agents. It is NOT medical advice or diagnosis. Always consult a physician or healthcare professional for health issues.*
